[RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#03] Microwave link degradation > Differential diagnosis: Versus the harmless background LINK_DEGRADED ... A major alarm on a microwave link with volume and latency moving is a different thing. ... Versus a fiber cut ... On a fiber link, a minor `LINK_DEGRADED` with falling optical power can precede a cut by up to an hour. ... A bad change lowers RRC success and drop performance, not latency and volume with an alarm on the link. ...
[RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#02] Microwave link degradation > Signature in the data: Alarm. `LINK_DEGRADED`, severity `major`, on the microwave link a few minutes after the start ("running at reduced modulation, RSL below threshold"). It clears a few minutes after recovery. Downstream sites (three to five behind that link): `dl_volume_mb` down 20 to 50 percent, `latency_ms` up 30 to 100 percent. Availability. ... Exactly the children of the one link. ...
[RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#05] Microwave link degradation > Verification steps: 1. `get_alarms`: find a major `LINK_DEGRADED` on a link, with the time. 2. `get_topology`: confirm the link is microwave and list its downstream sites. 3. `query_kpis` on those sites: volume down, latency up, availability near 100 percent, PRB not high. 4. ... 5. ... 6. `get_changes` and `get_maintenance` on the link, to rule them out.

The link stays up, so the sites behind it stay up, but they cannot push as much traffic. The result is a soft degradation: slower service and falling volume with no outage.

result.markdown:
# Transport degradation on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B affecting SFX sites

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-SFX-02-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence on the microwave link closely preceded KPI deviations, and changes and maintenance were ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-09 12:45 to 2026-09-09 16:40
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-09 12:36
- **Affected:** S-SFX-001, S-SFX-003

## Summary

Major link degradation on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B reduced modulation and caused traffic volume drops and latency spikes on downstream sites S-SFX-001 and S-SFX-003.

Traffic dropped and latency spiked across S-SFX-001 and S-SFX-003 from 12:45 to 16:40.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-09 12:36: Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm raised on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B. [ALM-000165]
- 2026-09-09 12:45: Traffic volume drop and latency spike observed on S-SFX-001 and S-SFX-003. [T1, T7]
- 2026-09-09 16:40: LINK_DEGRADED alarm cleared on LNK-SFX-02-B, ending the incident. [ALM-000165]

## Evidence

- A major LINK_DEGRADED alarm occurred on microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B from 12:36 to 16:40. [ALM-000165]
- S-SFX-003 experienced a download volume drop and latency spike starting at 12:45. [ANM-000139, ANM-000140]
- No changes were recorded on the affected sites or aggregate router between 12:00 and 18:00. [T4]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected nodes during the incident. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SFX-02-B: confirmed. Directly supported by the major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on LNK-SFX-02-B matching the KPI anomaly onset time. [ALM-000165, RB-MICROWAVE-DEGRADATION#02]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No configuration changes were executed on any of the affected nodes or their parents during the window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000166: Mains failure on S-SFX-004 represented a separate concurrent issue at a different site.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect microwave link LNK-SFX-02-B hardware and RF path interference.
- Monitor LNK-SFX-02-B performance metrics to ensure stability.
